back.target: since, for (a period of time that started in the past and is still going on; takes the dative)
back.example: I've been living here for two years.

note: This card teaches seit for how long something has lasted, and the other card teaches it from a starting point (since Monday), so they don't overlap; the hint is needed because "for two years" could otherwise suggest "für" or no preposition at all.
